sentences.text: In 1771, an entire nation tried to walk out of Russia.
sentences.phonemes: ˌɪn sˌɛvəntˈin sˈɛvənti wˈʌn, ɐn əntˈIəɹ nˈAʃən tɹˈId tə wˈɔk ˈWt ʌv ɹˈʌʃə.

sentences.text: The Kalmyks: Buddhist herders on the lower Volga.
sentences.phonemes: ðə kˈælmɪks: bˈʊdəst hˈɜɹdəɹz ˌɔn ðə lˈOəɹ vˈOlɡə.

sentences.text: They answered to Catherine the Great.
sentences.phonemes: ðˌA ˈænsəɹd tə kˈæθɹɪn ðə ɡɹˈAt.

sentences.text: Her empire curbed their khan, seized their pastures, drafted their horsemen.
sentences.phonemes: hˌɜɹ ˈɛmpˌIəɹ kˈɜɹbd ðɛɹ kˈɑn, sˈizd ðɛɹ pˈæsʧəɹz, dɹˈæftᵻd ðɛɹ hˈɔɹsmɛn.

sentences.text: So in January, Ubashi Khan led some 170,000 people east.
sentences.phonemes: sˌO ɪn ʤˈænjəwˌɛɹi, ubˈɑʃi kˈɑn lˈɛd sˌʌm wˈʌn hˈʌndɹəd sˈɛvənti θˈWzᵊnd pˈipᵊl ˈist.

sentences.text: But the Volga never froze, stranding the clans on its west bank.
sentences.phonemes: bˌʌt ðə vˈOlɡə nˈɛvəɹ fɹˈOz, stɹˈændɪŋ ðə klˈænz ˌɔn ɪts wˈɛst bˈæŋk.

sentences.text: The rest marched for months, raided and starving.
sentences.phonemes: ðə ɹˈɛst mˈɑɹʧt fɔɹ mˈʌnθs, ɹˈAdᵻd ænd stˈɑɹvɪŋ.

sentences.text: Tens of thousands never reached China.
sentences.phonemes: tˈɛnz ʌv θˈWzᵊndz nˈɛvəɹ ɹˈiʧt ʧˈInə.

sentences.text: The stranded clans are still there: Kalmykia, Europe's only Buddhist republic.
sentences.phonemes: ðə stɹˈændᵻd klˈænz ɑɹ stˈɪl ðˈɛɹ: kælmˈɪkiə, jˈʊɹəps ˈOnli bˈʊdəst ɹəpˈʌblɪk.
